planting.note: Set out rooted cuttings or container plants after all danger of frost has passed, into rich, evenly moist, well-drained soil in dappled or partial shade. Give plants a full growing season to establish a strong root system before their first winter.

directions: This white-flowered sport of Brazilian plume flower carries the same bold, upright plumes as the species but in pure white, giving a cooler, more luminous accent for shaded borders than the typical rose-pink form. Grow it in humus-rich, consistently moist soil under high or filtered shade, since strong midday sun bleaches the foliage and stresses the plant. Pinch young growth to encourage branching, and cut stems back hard in early spring to keep the habit dense rather than tall and sparse. Where winters dip below the mid-20s F the top growth is killed, but a thick mulch layer usually protects the crown for spring regrowth.
